# Date picker

A field-like button that opens a calendar for one date or a range.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-date-picker--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:light" title="Date picker examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-date-picker--docs">Open Date picker in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-date-picker--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** A date near today or a range, opened by tap from a field. Not a date known by heart; type it.

- **Use it when:** Dates near today, ranges, or when the day of the week matters.
- **Not when:** A date people know by heart, such as a birth date: typed fields are faster.

Instead:

- [Calendar](./calendar.md): The calendar on its own, always shown.
- [Input](./input.md): A known date typed in.

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The button says the chosen date, not just Pick a date. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add date-picker
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Variables

Every token Date picker reads, from its code: the variable, the semantic token it aliases, and where that ends in the theme.

### Read straight from the system

Date picker has no variables of its own yet; it reads these system tokens directly.
